topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Oh, can you even believe it? I just got this box, and my hands were fumbling with the tape, you know, just trying to keep it together. And then I open it, and there it is, this handmade frame with a note that says, "Thank you for the class that never ends." It’s from Jane, one of my students from years back. I mean, it’s been ages, and here she is, remembering those little lessons, the ones that weren’t even in the curriculum. It’s just... I don’t even know. It feels like a big hug, you know? I’m just over the moon, and I hope she knows how much this means. I've got to call her.
